name: Steak au Poivre with Miso-Mushroom Sauce
description: Classic au poivre with the cognac swapped for an umami-rich miso and mushroom cream sauce.
recipeIngredient: 2 filet mignon (6 to 8 oz each, or NY strip)
2 cups mixed mushrooms (sliced shiitake, cremini, or oyster)

recipeInstructions.text: Pat filet mignon dry. Press black peppercorns{2%tbsp}(coarsely crushed) and kosher salt into both sides. Rest at room temperature 15 minutes.
Heat butter and olive oil in a skillet over medium-high. Sear the steaks 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare (135°F). Move to a plate to rest.

itemListElement.text: In the same skillet, melt butter and cook shallot and mixed mushrooms 5 minutes.
Add dry white wine, scrape up the browned bits, and reduce by half, 5 minutes.
Stir in white miso and heavy cream and simmer until thickened, 3-4 minutes.
Slice the steaks and spoon the sauce over.
